tasks.name: Asset Pipeline Conventions
tasks.objective: Produce the Asset Pipeline Conventions for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Naming pattern defined for meshes, materials, textures and animations
Folder layout and import settings stated
Provenance and licence metadata carried with each imported asset
Import validation rules (scale, pivot, units) listed

tasks.name: Asset Integration Pass
tasks.objective: Produce the Asset Integration Pass for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every required asset imported, named to convention and referenced in code
Imported assets respect triangle, texture and memory budgets
Licence metadata present for every imported asset
No missing, pink or fallback-material assets in the build

tasks.name: Integration Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Integration Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Build loads every asset with zero 404 or decode errors
Instancing and reuse opportunities taken where they exist
Asset load time measured against the stated budget
